record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The 9 units in appliesTo (Eevee and eight Eeveelutions) declare HAPPY_HOUR. The strategy is shared; unit differences are only the star count (table index), maxPP (Jolteon 120) and passive (Eevee has passive EEVEE, the others NONE per the catalog). Eevee's passive EEVEE is a separate queue item and is not investigated here.
record.summary: Needs no target. Every non-null same-team entity on the board, the caster included, receives addAttack(buff, caster, apBoost 1, the cast's crit) with buff 2 / 4 / 7 / 10 by the caster's stars (EEVEE 2, the eight evolutions 4; fallback 10). Per recipient: Math.round(buff x (1 + caster AP/100) x critPower if the cast crit), then the recipient's own Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down), Twist Band none for a positive same-team buff, ATK floored at 1. The loop has no hp or targettability filter, enemies are untouched, and the strategy installs no restore timer (fight entity only). Executed (ATK 20): 2 stars +4, 1 star +2, AP 100 or a crit +8, a Belt holder +5, an ally at 0 HP still +4.

targeting.who: every board occupant with the same team as the caster (pokemon.team == ally.team), the caster itself included; no range or alive check beyond what board.forEach yields
targeting.note: requiresTarget is false, so it can be cast without walking up to a target; the target argument is null. board.forEach visits every cell and the loop adds no hp or targettability filter (executed: an ally at 0 HP is buffed); whether dead entities can sit in cells was not examined.

effects.scaling: round(raw x (1 + AP/100)) with apBoost 1 (caster AP), x critPower only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false); then the recipient's Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down, 4 -> 5), Twist Band none for a positive same-team buff, and a minimum attack of 1
effects.resolution: added to each ally's atk for the rest of the fight (permanent flag not set)

starBehavior.note: Eevee is 1 star (2), the eight evolutions are 2 stars (4); the 3-star and 4-star entries (7 / 10, fallback 10) are declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast adds the buff again, so attack stacks.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: attack 2 (Eevee, 1 star) and 4 (2-star evolutions). Applied per ally: round(raw x (1 + caster AP/100)) (x critPower on crit), then item hooks and the minimum of 1.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Other held-item effects on stat gains (applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff and applyTwistBandBuff were read and executed in this recheck)
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, movement) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the addAttack multiplier were read
Whether dead entities, summons or clones can occupy board cells (the loop itself filters nothing)
unresolved: Eevee's passive EEVEE is not investigated
Evolution rules of Eevee and the Eeveelutions are not covered

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (Board.forEach, addAttack, the Belt and Twist helpers) and the real HappyHourStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, section CATCHUP_B2); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (stand-in board, ATK 20): the values above, enemies untouched, no hp filter.
